notes.title: The Magistrate joins Eastern Game Fest
notes.content:
Coming soon:
Hi everyone,
The Magistrate is excited to announce that we are now taking part in Eastern Game Fest held by Steam China!
During the event, The Magistrate will be displayed in the section "Coming Soon".
Everyone is welcome to add The Magistrate into Wishlist and keep a close eye on it!
 
The game is in development phase and is expected to be released in October 2023. The player plays as a Magistrate in ancient China, responsible for city buildup& management as well as legal case investigation.
 
Please join us in [url=https://discord.gg/QeUW5H8F ]discord[/url]  to learn more about the game and discuss with our producers.
 
The Magistrate is looking forward to meeting all die-hard game curators during this Eastern Game Fest.
Link to the featured page of Eastern Game Fest: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/easterngamesfest]Click[/url]
